## Before you send it

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`). That says I have the right
      to submit this change under the project's licence: AGPL-3.0 with the
      app store permission in
      [`LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md`](https://github.com/MGKCodes/mgk-fitness/blob/main/LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md).
- [ ] `flutter analyze` is clean, and the tests pass.
- [ ] If somebody using the app would notice, a line in that app's
      `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] If it changes a decision, the ADR is updated in this pull request.
